get.summary: Downloads files as ZIP file with optionally increasing the download counter
get.description: This API call downloads multiple file that are not expired and increasing their download counter is disabled by default. Can be set up to return a pre-signed URL instead of the zip file itself, which is valid for 30 seconds and can be accessed by any registered user. End-to-end encrypted files and encrypted files stored on cloud servers cannot be downloaded. Returns 404 if an invalid/expired ID was passed. Requires API permission DOWNLOAD. To download files that were not uploaded by the user, the user needs to have the user permission LIST

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: IDs of files to be downloaded seperated by comma

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The filename for the new Zip file. If the filename includes non-ANSI characters, you can encode them with base64, by adding 'base64:' at the beginning, e.g. 'base64:ZmlsZW5hbWU='

parameters.name: increaseCounter
parameters.description: Increase counter if set to true

parameters.name: presignUrl
parameters.description: Return a pre-signed URL instead of the actual file. Valid for one download within 30 seconds and can only be used by logged in users. When this option is set, download counter cannot be increased.

400.description: Invalid input or trying to download an end-to-end encrypted file

put.description: Replaces content using an already uploaded file. Requires API REPLACE and the applicable replace/read permissions; deleting the source also requires API DELETE and source delete permission. File Request targets and either end-to-end encrypted file remain unsupported. Positive byte growth is atomically checked against target-owner and instance quotas, including active reservations. Equal-sized or smaller replacements need no added capacity. Source expiration commits with the replacement and does not refund quota before cleanup. Using the same ID with deleteNewFile=true returns 409 without changes; false remains idempotent.
